description: Wind resource measurements and maps of Pakistan is a series of data sets listed in opendata.com.pk, an open data portal, published or maintained by Energydata.info (The World Bank). This dataset contains GIS data and LIB files from an initial wind resource assessment for Pakistan. For more information please visit the country webpage:. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Energydata.info (The World Bank). Its tags are Renewable energy, Resource assessments. It offers 1 resource(s) in URL. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-pk-portal.
